name: Discovery+

fastest.text: Sign in at discoveryplus.com, open your profile → Subscription and select Cancel.

steps: Sign in at discoveryplus.com in a web browser.
Check who bills you; it's shown at the top.
If discovery+ bills you directly, select Cancel and confirm.
note: Billed through Amazon, Prime Video Channels, Google Play, Roku or your TV package? Cancel there; the discovery+ site won't show a Cancel option.

faq.q: Do I keep watching after I cancel?
faq.a: Yes, until the end of your billing period.

faq.q: Does deleting the app cancel it?
faq.a: No. Deleting the app doesn't cancel your subscription.
At least a day before your next billing date, so you aren't charged again.
